1_incident_name: Port of Houston Sulfuric Acid Tanker Leak
3_safety_message_expanded_safety_message: Primary tactical focus is placed on safe chemical neutralization and pH stabilization in the ship channel water column. Mandatory Level A chemical suit entry procedures enforced for all vessel deck operations. Due to extreme daytime heat (88°F, 78% humidity), entry work cycles are capped at 20 minutes active entry followed by 40 minutes active hydration and cooling.
approved_site_safety_plan_located_at: USCG Sector Houston Command Center Safety Office
